title: Demo · A slower start
content: Leave the first ten minutes of the morning unscheduled. Make tea, open the window, and decide what matters most today.

title: Demo · Weekend market list
content:
• Ripe tomatoes
  • Fresh basil
  • A loaf of sourdough
  • Something seasonal to try

title: Demo · Project idea: reading nook
content: Use the quiet corner by the window. Add a warm floor lamp, one narrow shelf, and a comfortable chair.

title: Demo · Questions for the next check-in
content:
1. What is going well?
  2. What feels stuck?
  3. What is one useful next step?

title: Demo · A recipe to remember
content: Roast chickpeas with cumin and smoked paprika. Serve with lemon yogurt, cucumber, and warm flatbread.

title: Demo · Books to borrow
content: Pick one short story collection and one book about gardens. Ask Sam for the title they mentioned last week.

title: Demo · Small things that helped
content:
• A short walk after lunch
  • Putting the phone in another room
  • Writing tomorrow’s first task down

title: Demo · Gift ideas
content: Look for a handmade ceramic mug or a small print from a local artist. Keep the wrapping simple.

title: Demo · Places for a day trip
content: Check the lakeside trail, the old railway town, and the botanical garden. Leave early and bring snacks.

title: Demo · Ideas for the balcony
content: Try mint in a separate pot, two hardy herbs, and a small outdoor light. Measure the railing before buying planters.

title: Demo · A useful reminder
content: When a task feels too large, write the smallest next action. Ten focused minutes still count as progress.

title: Demo · Playlist for focused work
content: Instrumental music, steady tempo, no lyrics. Keep the volume low enough to hear the room.

title: Demo · Things to ask the plumber
content:
1. Can the tap be repaired or should it be replaced?
  2. How long will the part take to arrive?
  3. Is there anything to do before the visit?

title: Demo · A note on the new routine
content: The short evening reset is easier to keep than a full clean. Clear the desk, set out a notebook, and stop there.

title: Demo · Lunch combinations
content: Rice, roasted vegetables, and tahini. Or lentils with greens, lemon, and toasted seeds.

title: Demo · Ideas for the team retro
content: Keep, change, try. Give everyone a quiet minute to write before the discussion starts.

title: Demo · Garden observations
content: The west-facing pot dries out first. Move the seedlings a little farther from the wall and check them at dusk.

title: Demo · Useful keyboard shortcuts
content:
• Search the current page before opening another tab
  • Use headings to make long notes easier to scan
  • Capture the thought first; organize it later

title: Demo · Packing list for two nights
content: Weather layer, comfortable shoes, charger, water bottle, book, and the small notebook by the bed.

title: Demo · Month-end reflection
content: What felt meaningful? What took more energy than expected? What can be made simpler next month?
